description: This file defines a React functional component called DailyItemCell which renders a UI element representing a daily item with sections such as date, activities, tags, and metadata. It utilizes multiple imported components and utilities for rendering note previews, tags, metadata, and icons, handling both content items and empty states.

classes.name: DaySquare
classes.description: A React functional component that displays a day number with visual styling indicating activity status and weekday.

classes.name: DailyItemCell
classes.description: A React forwardRef component rendering a list item representing a daily section, including date, tags, metadata, and optional note preview.

methods.name: DaySquare
